MISSING_OBJECT_NAMED.REQUIRED_BY_THE_LAUNCHER: this disposition may only be used when a SPECIFIC missing field, cadence, observer state variable or unresolved operator component prevents identification. It is not usable because uncertainty is inconvenient. The specific objects are named below.

OBJECT_1_UNRESOLVED_OPERATOR_COMPONENT.what: the TWO_Y co-location / separation sub-operator is not CONDITIONED on the state that determines it
OBJECT_1_UNRESOLVED_OPERATOR_COMPONENT.evidence: predeclared validation TEST 2 at point B2: discovery worlds spend 19.66% of steps with two or more Y, held-out validation worlds 4.53%, a world-level z of -2.82. The same test passes at B1 (z = +1.16). A sub-operator that generalizes at one parameter point and not at the other is not identified.
exact_missing_conditioning: the local exposure CLASS of the birth cell at the moment of the first birth
the elapsed time from first birth
the relative displacement of the descendant from the source at the moment co-location ends
OBJECT_1_UNRESOLVED_OPERATOR_COMPONENT.why_it_was_not_fitted_here: the freeze forbids refitting after validation is opened. Conditioning the operator now, having seen the failure, would be exactly the retune the freeze prohibits.

OBJECT_2_MISSING_OBSERVER_STATE_VARIABLE.why: the engine's reaction is aggregate: births = Binomial(min(nSY,free0), min(1,kY*nX*nY)) per cell. When a birth occurs in a multiply occupied cell the parent is a SHARED_PARENT_POOL and no observer can resolve which Y produced it without changing the physics. Co-location DURATION is therefore observable but per-descendant lineage age is not, and the conditioning in OBJECT_1 needs it.

MISSING_OBJECT_NAMED.WHAT_IS_NOT_CLAIMED: this is NOT structural preclusion. No structural result was obtained showing that Y feedback destroys every controlled window across the admissible region; measured feedback on nSY was -0.18% to -0.24% and not significant at the world level.

EMPTY_REGION_IS_PREREGISTERED.READING: the freeze declared, before a single world ran, that no admissible (kY, muY) satisfies all five frozen boundaries and that the region might come back empty. The calibration replaced the mean-exposure proxy with measured, world-level quantities and the shortfall moved by 0.0015 decades. The boundary arithmetic was not the weak link; the measurement confirmed it.

PHASE_A_DESIGN_DISPERSION_MISS.DISCLOSURE: the freeze sized Phase A from the parent's 14-arm dispersion. The measured world-level dispersion is larger by the factor above, so the achieved precision is worse than designed. N_A was NOT changed in response -- that would be outcome-driven resizing. The miss is reported and handed to the successor.

POST_HOC_DESCRIPTIVE_X_ESTABLISHMENT.STATUS: POST_HOC_DESCRIPTIVE — reported because it explains the world-level dispersion; it enters NO decision gate, NO validation test and NO region criterion, and no world is excluded because of it
POST_HOC_DESCRIPTIVE_X_ESTABLISHMENT.READING: the founder's exposure is Q = nX * min(nSY, free); a world in which the X cloud fails to establish or collapses has Q identically 0 by construction, with no Y process involved. 2 of 40 Phase-A worlds have a mean N_X below 5. This failure mode, not Y dynamics, dominates the world-level dispersion of exposure.
